🎭 Masked Language Modeling (BERT)

BERT predicts the word that fills [MASK]:
📝 "The [MASK] is wagging its tail happily."
     → dog (45.6%), cat (24.7%), bear (1.8%), lion (1.8%), wolf (1.3%)

  📝 "A [MASK] is sleeping on the windowsill."
     → woman (20.1%), man (18.2%), girl (10.7%), boy (9.3%), child (7.7%)
📝 "The golden [MASK] is the most popular dog breed."
     → lion (19.6%), fox (11.0%), dog (8.4%), bear (4.7%), wolf (4.4%)

  📝 "My pet [MASK] loves to chase mice."
     → cat (26.2%), dog (12.3%), mouse (6.1%), squirrel (2.5%), rabbit (2.0%)
📝 "[MASK] are known for their loyalty to humans."
     → they (95.9%), humans (0.3%), these (0.2%), dragons (0.1%), wolves (0.1%)

  📝 "The [MASK] purrs when you stroke its fur."
     → animal (21.4%), dog (17.1%), cat (11.7%), wolf (6.5%), beast (4.6%)
